selection: Latest official Caffeine integration; Canic bindings are historical extraction evidence, not the provider specification.

backend_reference.basis: Latest Mops publication 1.1.1 observed through the official registry; manifest and both backend source files match the pinned official source. Reference for the Rust integration, not an installed Motoko dependency.

qualification.implementation_scope: Local content/billing/configuration, transient lifecycle/root claims and bounded Caffeine reply decoding with private wire DTOs. No provider transports/effects or persisted service workflows. Reply and claim tests do not qualify deployed completion, recovery or settlement.

refresh_policy: Recheck official source and registry latest before provider implementation and qualification. Update exact pins, contract evidence and affected checks together; do not resolve moving latest tags at build time.
